Application Data.NAME: Clean & Press Laundry Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Clean & Press Laundry Services operates a full-service laundromat providing wash, dry, and fold services, in addition to self-service laundry facilities. Our business caters primarily to residential customers, with a strong emphasis on customer service and convenience. We utilize modern, energy-efficient equipment and adhere to stringent safety and environmental protocols when handling cleaning chemicals. All staff are trained in proper handling practices to ensure a safe and clean environment for both employees and customers. We prioritize quality and reliability in our operations, focusing on maintaining high standards and customer satisfaction. Our location is equipped to handle peak demand times effectively, and we implement routine maintenance checks on equipment to minimize downtime and enhance operational efficiency.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a water leak from an adjacent unit caused damage to our equipment and premises, resulting in repair costs totaling $5,000. The claim has been settled and the repairs were completed by May 1, 2023.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B safe with UL 768 rating, equipped with dual-key access and time delay lock mechanism.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security patrols conducted during operating hours and installation of a perimeter fence with controlled access points.
